answer: Every new key pays a real price, not lost income: while its payouts are withheld for 26 epochs, the protocol burns 5% of its 500,000 POA bond each epoch, 25,000 POA, or 650,000 per key in total. The burn comes out of the bond itself, so a lender cannot hand it back unless the borrower pays it, and keys cannot share one bond. Cost is linear: 1,000 fakes burn 650 million POA and lock 500 million. A terrace of fresh keys, a mirror of bought wallets or an umber of idle accounts pays alike. An honest newcomer then earns 45,000 per epoch and recovers it in about 15 epochs.
